description: NSE trading symbols that no longer trade, mapped to the symbol(s) that replaced them. Used by scripts/stock_analysis.py and scripts/screener.py only after the old symbol fails to load (or its history has stopped), so a symbol that NSE later reuses is not redirected. 'date' is the first trading day under the new symbol; for mergers and demergers it is the record date or the date the old symbol stopped trading, as stated in 'reason'. Add entries only from an exchange circular, the company's own filing or a broker bulletin that quotes the circular.

aliases.reason: Tata Motors demerged its commercial-vehicle business (record date 14 Oct 2025, 1 TMCV share per share held); the remaining passenger-vehicle company was renamed and trades as TMPV from 24 Oct 2025.

successors.what: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd: passenger cars, EVs and Jaguar Land Rover (the original listed company, renamed)
Tata Motors Ltd (formerly TML Commercial Vehicles): trucks and buses, listed 12 Nov 2025

aliases.reason: Tata Motors 'A' ordinary (DVR) shares were cancelled for 7 ordinary shares per 10 DVR (last trading day 29 Aug 2024); those ordinary shares now trade as TMPV after the 2025 demerger, which also gave TMCV shares.

successors.what: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd, the ordinary shares the DVRs became (renamed from TATAMOTORS in Oct 2025)
